g.text: RF-PID-201 REV B · ALTERNATIVE VERSION (EPC STANDARD) · REV A SCREEN SHEET REMAINS THE OTS REFERENCE
ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE (COOLED VAPOUR FROM E-201 OUTLET),
DESUPERHEATED IN V-201 BY LIQUID QUENCH TCV-216
LIQUID C3= 42 t/h TO LV-103 / E-101
CLASS: A3 CS 300# · L3 LTCS 300# (MDMT −46 °C) · S3 SS304L 300#
(MDMT −196 °C) · A1 CS 150# · CI COLD INSUL. · PP PERS. PROT.
h REFERENCE: SATURATED LIQUID C3= AT −40 °C = 0 kJ/kg.
1. DESIGN BASIS: OTS MODEL DESIGN POINT (NOISE OFF). NOT PLANT DATA. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (VAPOUR ≤ 20 m/s SUCTION, ≤ 15 m/s DISCHARGE, LIQUID ≤ 1.5 m/s), CLASSES TBC.
2. ONE EVAPORATING LEVEL (−40 °C, 1.42 BAR A IN THE KETTLES) SERVES E-101 AND E-203. E-201 FLOATS ON COOLING WATER (NO PRESSURE CONTROL).
3. COLD SERVICE: SUCTION SIDE, LETDOWNS AND E-203 SHELL IN LTCS (MDMT −46 °C). LIQUID C3= AUTOREFRIGERATES TO −48 °C AT 1 ATM: DRAINS AND VENTS TO CLOSED SYSTEMS.
4. RELIEF: PSV-201 / PSV-202 SETS TBC (SETTLE-OUT ≈ 9 BAR A AFTER A TRIP; FIRE CASE ON V-202 INVENTORY). PSV INLET/OUTLET BLOCK VALVES CSO (NOT SHOWN).
5. REV B ADDS: K-201 DISCHARGE CHECK + BLOCK VALVE, SUCTION BLOCK VALVE, LV-213 BLOCK/BYPASS, CW BLOCK VALVES, TCV-216 QUENCH, DRAINS, VENTS, UCP-201, LINE CLASSES.
A. PIC-201 → KT-201 SPEED (72–112 %): HOLDS SUCTION 1.355 BAR A. HIGHER LOAD → HIGHER SPEED.
B. UIC-205 → FV-205 (FO): HOLDS 10 % FLOW MARGIN ABOVE THE SURGE LINE (φ ≥ 0.77). OPENS AT LOW LOAD.
C. PIC-310 (RF-PID-301) → LIC-213 SP (20–80 %) → LV-213 (FC): MORE WETTED AREA IN E-203 = LOWER C2= CONDENSING PRESSURE.
D. TCV-216 (SELF-ACTING): LIQUID C3= QUENCH KEEPS V-201 OUTLET NEAR SATURATION WHEN FV-205 RECYCLES.
E. RESTART PERMISSIVES: FV-205 ≥ 90 %, PIC-201 MAN ≤ 5 %, LI-202 < 30 %, CW FLOWING.
